name: 吳昭正
objective:
學習 C 語言的用法，包括：變數、表示式、敘述、形態宣告、 控制結構、函式、陣列、指標、結構、檔案處理、及格式化輸出/輸入等用法，以作業及期末專題強化學習效果。
Learn C programming, including: usage of variable, expression, statement, type declaration, control structure, function, array, pointer, structure, file processing, and formatted I/O. In this course, assignments and term projects will be emphasized to strengthen the learning.
schedule:
Week 1(9/9). Introduction 
Week 2(9/16). Introduction of Integrated Development Environment
Week 3(9/23). Basics
Week 4(9/30). Selection and Repetition
Week 5(10/7). Variables and Arrays
Week 6(10/14). Functions
Week 7(10/21). Algorithms and Recursion
Week 8(10/28). Pointer
Week 9(11/4). C Strings
Week 10(11/11). Self-defined data types in C
Week 11(11/18). Classes
Week 12(11/25). Operator Overloading
Week 13(12/2). C++ Strings, file IO, and header files
Week 14(12/9). Inheritance and Polymorphism
Week 15(12/16). Templates and exception handling
Week 16(12/23). Final Project (I)
Week 17(12/30). Final Project (II)
Week 18(1/6). Final Project (III)
scorePolicy:
Homework: 60%
Final Project: 40%
Attendance: -1% for each absence recorded
Bonus (if available): 10%
Total: 110%

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
